title: Progress Software security advisory (AV26-1148)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1148 Date: November 12, 2026 As of November 12, 2026, Progress Software is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Telerik Report Server Prior to 12.3.26.1110 Telerik Reporting Prior to 20.3.26.1110 Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core Prior to 2026.3.1015 Telerik UI for WPF Prior to 2026.4.1110 Telerik UI for WinForms Prior to 2026.4.1111 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. ClassFactory Race Condition and Retained Assembly Memory in Telerik UI for ASP.NET MVC (CVE-2026-106137) Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Telerik Reporting Report Designers (CVE-2026-106140) Telerik Report Server External Control of Configuration Setting in Telerik Report Server (CVE-2026-106152) Improper Control of Generation of Code Vulnerability (CVE-2026-124699) Improper Control of Generation of Code Vulnerability (CVE-2026-124703) Progress Trust Center Article Link: Progress Software security advisory (AV26-1148) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
